suggestions.question: Can the native P104 low-rank channel be completed with a legal, fully charged I-G/2 side correction?
suggestions.method: Derive a lower bound on the side correction and hosting costs that decides whether this channel can beat the selected budget.
suggestions.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier.

first_step.inspect: Read the P104 open next questions and its fixed local histogram; inspect why appending I-G/2 after source completion is not justified. #1991 supplies the checked native channel, not the missing correction.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only. Read the named package and review before relying on its local evidence; this command is not its replay or supplier admission.

suggestions.first_experiment: Choose one exact side-correction cut and bound its allowed cost from a favorable completed moment at a declared target. Stop or hand off if the necessary source/target access cannot be justified or even the optimistic total misses the target.
suggestions.bottleneck_link: Completing an already realized changed channel tests a concrete construction opportunity, instead of refining the incumbent packing. A positive local result still needs global and all-size admission.
allowed_variations: One correction factorization, one chronological cut, or one explicit hosting obstruction.
A changed correction schedule with an updated full bill and native frame contract.
scope_change_triggers: Recompiling the already certified low-rank channel without closing a new obligation.
Treating a pending ancestor, local histogram or unpriced side correction as an admitted global supplier.
suggestions.scope_rule: If you change the card's premise, record scope_status=changed and explain why. A package metadata check cannot establish mathematical relevance.

next_step: Check live overlap, refine one question's object and domain, and record a bounded task card. A different seed or scope key is not evidence of novelty.
